# quotes work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:quotesWork`](gmeow-quotesWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/quotesWork>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A flat shortcut asserting that a creative work includes a quotation derived from another creative work. The reified form is a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeQuotation`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeQuotation.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:quotesWork`](gmeow-quotesWork.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of asserting one work quotes material from another, when the quoted segment and provenance need not be recorded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the quoted segment, period, or provenance must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationTypeQuotation`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeQuotation.md)) and avoid it for citing a source bibliographically (that is the citations slice's [`gmeow:cites`](gmeow-cites.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the quoting work to the quoted work; it [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) — promote when metadata is required.

### Examples

- ex:symphony [`gmeow:quotesWork`](gmeow-quotesWork.md) ex:folkTune.
